description: e4/queued's merge queue, then what decides whether E4's pull requests into e4/queued can merge (E4, the merge states), as rozed-bot, which opened them and administers rozed-dev/e2e, read only. e4/queued's ruleset, with no bypass actors, requires a merge queue (squash) and the ci check from GitHub Actions, and no approval. #34: ci failed on its first attempt and passed when the same workflow run was run again, on the same commit; GitHub says CLEAN. #50: the queue series' slow one, #51: its passing one, #36: its fail-in-queue one, each ready for the queue, which is empty
